newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume rose sharply to 4.2 billion yuan from 2.4 billion last Friday, with the 30-day contract the most active.
Traders said state banks had large amounts to lend on the market and non-bank financial institutions borrowed heavily to trade on domestic A share markets, pushing up the volume.

"There is enough money supply at the national level, making state banks able to lend out large amounts of money," said one trader. "But surging domestic A share markets led many securities houses to borrow money today. A rough balance of supply and demand keep the market rates stable today."
Traders expect the rates to move narrowly in the near term.
